notes: The ground this area owns (75,000 m2, 991 points): the walks, drives and lawns of the campus core between the College of Communication and Media, Morehead Hall, Susan A. Cole Hall, Sprague Library, the Alexander Kasser Theater amphitheatre and the halls north of them up to the Student Center. Names (the university's where known; OpenStreetMap for positions only): Alumni Green (north part), Student Center Quad, Science Quad (with its two small ponds), Chapin Hall Quad (north part), University Promenade, Chapin Drive, Skyline Way, Lot 10, and the wooded slope east of Life Hall and the College of Communication and Media down to Valley Road; Red Hawk Catholic (OSM 232850502, the Newman centre by Valley Road, not in the published model) stands inside. 'core' is only the area's label: no place is called that. How the outline was made: every published mesh in the box -200..150, -200..330 was drawn from above (tools/evidence/plan.py, trees left out) and each 0.25 m cell sorted into bare ground (Terrain_LiDAR_DTM_1m_pf, Footpaths_OSM, Roads_OSM, the skirt, and the dressing laid on those strips: Curb_edges_OSM, Footpath control joints, Lawn_worn_edge_along_walks, fallen_leaves, walk_edge_weeds, QY_wear_junctions, PB2_walk_lawn_fillet, OY_walk_panel_tone_CELS_Calcia, OX_CELS_walk_scoring_joints), buildings (more than 0.7 m over the 2017 LiDAR ground; the outline keeps 1 m outside their roof edge, so 1 to 2 m off the walls), and hand-modelled ground (plazas, forecourts, the WS*/QX*/MM* patches, steps, the Cole Hall plaza, the College of Communication and Media forecourt and herringbone, beds; the outline runs 0.25 m inside their edge so their paving covers the joint). Planting and statues (mulch, boxwood, euonymus, pachysandra, beds, the Red Hawk statue) are kept 0.3 m clear even where hidden. Small upright things (lamp posts, signs, bins, benches, under 2.5 m2) stay standing inside. Holes under 1 m2, and tree pits under 12 m2, are inside. The outline was then shrunk 0.25 m, opened 0.5 m and simplified 0.4 m, so it never reaches further into its neighbours than that. One ring cannot have holes: 18 straight slits 0.1 m wide join the rings round buildings and hand patches to the outside, chosen as the shortest cuts across lawn (crossing a walk counts 30 times its length); each has a free_edges ring. Eight more free_edges rings (x 25..90, y 64..152 by Memorial Auditorium, the Speech Building and Life Hall, and x -201..-150, y 14..35 by the amphitheatre) cover edge samples where the main model's terrain lies 0.7 to 2.9 m under the LiDAR hidden beneath its own hand patch, which stands at the LiDAR level. Edge heights (edge_heights.json): 6,097 samples, median 0.06 m over the 2017 LiDAR, half within 0.10 m; where the main model's visible ground really stands off the LiDAR (west of Dickson Hall up to +2.5 m, the service yards between Memorial Auditorium, the Speech Building and CELS 1.4 to 3.8 m lower) the samples are kept, so the soft ground bends to meet it. Slits that still cross a walk: (-99.5, -44.1)-(-92.1, -13.4) across the Alumni Green to Sprague Library, (66.8, 165.7)-(53.9, 153.0), (19.9, 122.6)-(18.2, 124.1), (-93.1, 219.2)-(-93.0, 222.5), (-98.8, 235.3)-(-92.8, 231.0) and the four by Stone Hall (x 114..139, y 214..246). Edges: West: x -200 from y 222 down to y -110 (straight cuts through lawn where it meets the main model's ground), then x -212 to y -200 so that Chapin Drive reaches the main model's College Avenue (WS27 carriageway, WS214 curb nose): the outline runs 0.25 m inside its curb. North-west: the west area's south edge reused (y 223.2 from x -193.0 to -187.4, a point on its segment (-206, 223.2)-(-187.06, 223.2)); the webster area is 30 m away (buildings and the Student Center's hand paving lie between). North: the Student Center's hand-modelled plazas (QXP, MM terrace, MN), Calcia Hall, the School of Nursing/The Graduate School, Richardson Hall and Stone Hall. East: 2 m inside the university boundary (OSM 233913199) along Valley Road and round the houses south of y -63; the road, its walk and the houses stay with the main model. South: y -200; Freeman Hall, Lot 9 and the WS150 apron stay out. Left out (main model kept): the Alumni Green south of the line (-162, -50), (-150, -35), (-134, -28), (-114, -28), (-106, -40), (-102, -56), (-58, -58), (-52, -100): the green was rebuilt after 2020, and there the main model's post-2020 lawn (COLE_lawn_post2020_bs) stands 0.3 to 0.8 m (by Cole Hall's north face up to 2 m) off both the 2014 and the 2017 LiDAR, which this engine would build on; north of the line the two agree within 0.3 m. Joe's photos of 2026-11-20 (refs/joe_20261120, reference only) show the rebuilt green: herringbone pavers, a flat lawn, lamps. Also left out: walk strips within 1 m of a wall or under a hand patch (1,483 m2 of Footpaths_OSM in the box stays, mostly at building doors, plaza edges and inside the kept part of the Alumni Green), the circle north of Dickson Hall where it touches the University Hall plaza, the Kasser amphitheatre and its plaza (hand-modelled), the WJ gully patch and the slope east of CELS (draped patches of the main model), Valley Road (3,960 m2 of Roads_OSM stays). Heights: inside the outline the main model's ground stands a median 0.1 m over the 2017 LiDAR; in the circle north of Dickson Hall it lies 0.4 to 1.1 m under it, and the 2014 LiDAR agrees with the 2017 one there within 3 cm, so this build puts that lawn back on the LiDAR. Evidence in /workspace/data/core: ortho2020 (x -200..150, y -200..330, 0.15 m), lidar.npz (2017 NW6Co, x -240..190, y -240..370, 0.5 m), osm.json, tiles (dump of models/main for x -260..210, y -260..390 with instances; ground.png from plan.py), tiles_plain (no instances; plan.png, noveg.png). Scratch: /tmp/claude-0/p5/core (7.5 cm ortho of Skyline Way and Chapin Drive in ev/sky and ev/chapin, 2014 LiDAR in ev/l2014).

supersede.notes: Patterns match 'mesh name material name' in the other sources' tiles. clip, with the area inside the outline (m2, triangle centroids inside, from the dump): Terrain_LiDAR_DTM_1m_pf 74,060 (Ground_ortho_grass 42,685, Lawn_Varied_Oct_local_fade 17,686, COLE_lawn_post2020_bs 13,687), Footpaths_OSM 13,416, Roads_OSM 1,756, Context_skirt_3DEP_ortho_4km 936 (under the terrain). Also clipped, because they only dress the OSM strips and the terrain this area replaces and would float on the new ground: Curb_edges_OSM 155 (curbs along the Roads_OSM strips of Skyline Way and Chapin Drive), Footpath control + expansion joints 55, Lawn_worn_edge_along_walks 616, fallen_leaves 179, walk_edge_weeds 3, QY_wear_junctions 176, PB2_walk_lawn_fillet 1,042, OY_walk_panel_tone_CELS_Calcia 517, OX_CELS_walk_scoring_joints 12; and lawn fills lying 0.08 to 0.16 m under the main terrain, which the new ground would meet face to face: North_terrain_LiDAR_1m (North_ground_ortho2020) 93, QW_DTM_north_edge_ramp 41, UG_Partridge_E_seam_fill_lawn 25, OK_Schmitt_entrance_walk_lawn_embankment 762 (90 %% hidden; its visible part by the Schmitt Hall entrance is outside), WS113_terrain_fan_fill_DTM1m 22. Clip, not drop: all of them run on past the outline. drop: far_houses (none inside). No building, hand patch, planting, lamp or tree is matched; the main model's trees (instanced) and lamp posts inside stay. The ccom and green areas' volumes and rings are outside the outline (it keeps out of ccom's band ring and the rebuilt Cole Hall plaza).
